messages:
Lina: Quick heads-up — during last night's private deploy failover the keystore flipped to the DR HSM and we have a ~45m hole in audit events forwarded to Splunk. Not sure if the agent crashed or the forwarder was blocked. Anyone watching?
Sam: Ugh. Which cluster/region? do we have the ops-bot entry?
Lina: eu-west-1 private-vpc-3. ops-bot shows the keystore health transition at 02:14UTC and then a downstream 'log-forwarder' restart around 02:16UTC. After that nothing until 03:01UTC.
ops-bot: [automated] keystore.health.changed cluster=private-vpc-3 from=primary to=secondary at=2026-03-15T02:14:09Z
Maya: Do we have any packet-filter changes in that window? Netpols, firewall rules, or NAT gateway rotation?
Carol (infra): No manual netpol changes logged in infra-audit. I see an autoscaler event for the forwarder at 02:15 — it scaled one replica down then up. Might have missed a sticky offset.
Eli: If the forwarder pod died during failover it could have lost in-memory buffer. We normally rely on persistent disk for the forwarder queue — is that enabled for private?
Lina: For private we've been using ephemeral queue by default to keep I/O low. That was a deliberate tradeoff for latency.
Sam: Ok that's the root cause then. We should treat this as a durability gap, not a cryptographic issue. Still need to confirm there was no policy-induced drop.
security-oncall: Filing incident: INC-2026-1423. Triage owners: @Lina, @Carol, @Maya.
Maya: Short-term mitigation: reconfigure forwarder daemonset to use persistentVolumeClaim (1Gi) in private clusters and enable at-least-once delivery. Can we toggle that without a full deploy?
Carol (infra): We can patch the daemonset. Patch command:
```
kubectl patch daemonset log-forwarder -n infra -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name": "forwarder", "volumeMounts": [{"name": "persist-queue", "mountPath": "/var/queue"}]}], "volumes": [{"name": "persist-queue", "persistentVolumeClaim": {"claimName": "log-forwarder-pvc"}}]}}}}'
```
Sam: Also check RBAC on the forwarder service account. When we failover to DR HSM the keystore principal changes, and we rotate service account tokens in the shim — that caused a momentary permission mismatch on the forwarder side in last year's replay.
Lina: Good call. Current service account for forwarder: `svc-logs-forwarder@infra`. Does it have s3:PutObject or splunk ingest perms?
Eli: It uses our log-ingest-role via IRSA; role-binding looks fine. But the keystore rotation step temporarily revoked the role's credential until the new token synced — race condition.
Maya: Add a policy: on keystore failover, hold log-forwarder restarts until queue persistence is in place OR ensure forwarder can read old envelope keys. 
Carol (infra): Ops suggestion: add an annotation to the keystore failover controller to call a pre-shutdown webhook that drains or checkpoints forwarder state.
Lina: Forensics checklist so we don't lose customer traceability: 1) export HSM transition events, 2) pull node/pod logs for forwarder 02:00-03:30, 3) check Splunk for accepted vs dropped events, 4) verify audit log sequence numbers around 02:14.
Sam: Query to check sequence gap (Splunk):
```
index=infra_logs source="keystore-audit" cluster="private-vpc-3" earliest="02:00" latest="03:30" | sort 0 _time | table _time event_id seqnum
```
Eli: Also check our keystore server logs for any authentication errors — if the keystore returned 403 the forwarder might have silently dropped events.
security-oncall: Note: retention policy for private on-prem is 365 days for audit logs. We should snapshot the raw storage now before any compaction.
Maya: Longer-term: require durable forwarder queue + stricter service account scoping (least privilege) + canary for keystore failover during low traffic windows.
Carol (infra): I'll open infra PR to enable PVC + drain webhook. Will include netpol ensure-egress rule for Splunk endpoint to avoid blackholing during node switches. Sample netpol snippet to allow egress only to splunk host:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-splunk-egress
  namespace: infra
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: log-forwarder
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 192.0.2.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8088
```
Lina: Two action items from security: 1) Add keystore failover to incident tabletop and update runbook to include forwarder persistence requirement. 2) Audit RBAC transient revocations during HSM handover and add backstop to prevent role binding flips during failover windows.
Sam: I'll take #2 — will run a simulated failover in sandbox and capture role-binding state transitions.
security-oncall: We're tracking remediation tasks in INC-2026-1423. Please add links to PRs and postmortem notes here when available. :thumbsup:
Lina: Thanks all — please ping me if you find evidence of dropped PII-level events.
ops-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-1423 created by security-oncall at 2026-03-15T04:02:11Z
Carol (infra): PR opened: infra#3124 — pvc + drain hook + netpol. ETA review: 6 hours.
Maya: Marking this discussion resolved for now until PR merges. :white_check_mark:
